serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: WalkMe maximizes and accelerates the impact of your digital transformation strategy by driving user adoption of your digital assets. Leverage WalkMe’s Digital Adoption Platform to constantly identify gaps and problem areas, and drive users to success, codelessly, and without changes to your underlying platforms.The WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) system adapts software and websites to meet the needs of employees, customers & citizens. The WalkMe DAP system creates a consistent user experience, streamlining productivity and engagement while reducing costs.  The WalkMe FedRAMP offering is specific to federal customers and is built on a dedicated government environment.
